name: Yinlin

tierList.prydwen: T3 Tower of Adversity, T4 Whimpering Wastes (Hybrid)

kit.intro: 5-star Electro Rectifier Hybrid, high AoE damage with strong off-field Coordinated Attack presence via marks. Most attacks apply 'Sinner's Mark'; Forte 'Judgment Points' (max 100) unlocks Heavy Attack 'Chameleon Cipher' converting marks to 'Punishment Mark' (triggers Coordinated Attack Judgment Strikes for 18s, even off-field). Should always run Moonlit Clouds as a Hybrid, never played as Main DPS.

skills.normalAttack: Zapstring's Dance - up to 4-hit puppet attack.
skills.resonanceSkill: Magnetic Roar - AoE Electro + enters Execution Mode (next 4 attacks trigger extra Electromagnetic Blast vs Sinner's Marked enemies); follow-up 'Lightning Execution' nuke.
skills.forte: Chameleon Cipher - Judgment Points gauge; enhanced Heavy Attack converts Sinner's Mark to Punishment Mark.
skills.liberation: Thundering Wrath - large-range Electro AoE nuke.
skills.intro: Raging Storm - large-range Electro DMG, applies Sinner's Mark.
skills.outro: Strategist - next character gains 20% Electro DMG Deepen + 25% Resonance Liberation DMG Deepen for 14s.

bestWeapons: Stringmaster (signature, 100%, one of the best weapons in the game generally)

teams.name: Main DPS Iuno
teams.notes: Yinlin's 25% Liberation DMG Amplify makes her the second-best Iuno buffer after signature-weapon Ciaccona.

teams.name: Xiangli Yao / Calcharo Team
teams.notes: Her 20% Electro + 25% Liberation DMG Amplify Outro is a massive multiplier for both - considered a near-mandatory pairing for Calcharo.

teams.name: Jinhsi Team
teams.notes: Competitive but slightly weaker alternative to Zhezhi for Jinhsi.

rotation: Intro -> Basic P4 -> Skill (Magnetic Roar) -> Heavy Attack -> Skill (Lightning Execution, cancel Heavy endlag) -> Ultimate -> Basic P1 -> Forte Heavy (Chameleon Cipher) -> Echo (swap cancel) -> Outro.
communityNotes: Prydwen: strong, AoE-focused Hybrid buffer near-mandatory for a big Main DPS carry (Xiangli Yao, Calcharo, Jinhsi); benefits significantly from swap/animation cancels but has a decent baseline without them. Notably more signature-weapon-dependent than most characters - underperforms without Stringmaster, though that weapon is also excellent on other Rectifier DPS so it's rarely wasted.
